stories.headline: Visa Earnings Spotlight Agentic Commerce as Next Growth Engine
stories.body: Visa’s latest earnings Tuesday (April 28) showed a company still getting plenty of lift from card spending while pushing deeper into stablecoins, blockchain and artificial intelligence-driven commerce. stories.headline: Visa bets on World Cup, agentic AI, to boost earnings
stories.body: The payments giant is counting on the FIFA World Cup this summer for windfalls in its consumer and commercial businesses. Long-term, agentic commerce is creating a whole new ecosystem to which Visa can attach itself, Visa CEO Ryan McInerney said on a call with analysts.

stories.headline: This bank CEO let his AI clone handle an earnings call — now he's signing an OpenAI deal
stories.body: It's part of Customers Bank CEO Sam Sidhu's effort to get ahead in the industry's race to transform itself using AI agents as a new digital workforce
